items.question: Trong câu "In a synchronous call (HTTP, gRPC) the caller waits for the callee.", từ "synchronous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a synchronous call (HTTP, gRPC) the caller waits for the callee.", what does "synchronous" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: in step, waiting for a reply
items.explanation: synchronous /ˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (tính từ): đồng bộ, chờ kết quả. Synchronous call = lời gọi đồng bộ: bên gọi phải đợi bên được gọi trả lời rồi mới làm tiếp.
items.explanationEn: synchronous /ˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (adjective): in step, waiting for a reply. A synchronous call blocks the caller until the callee replies; the opposite is asynchronous.

items.question: Trong câu "It is simple, but it couples services in time: a slow payment service makes checkout slow, a dead one makes it fail.", từ "couple" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is simple, but it couples services in time: a slow payment service makes checkout slow, a dead one makes it fail.", what does "couple" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: couple /ˈkʌpl/ (động từ): gắn chặt, ràng buộc. Couple services = làm các dịch vụ phụ thuộc chặt vào nhau; danh từ là coupling, trái nghĩa là decouple.
items.explanationEn: couple /ˈkʌpl/ (verb): to link so they depend. To couple services is to make them depend on each other; the noun is coupling and the opposite is decouple.

items.question: Trong câu "Latencies add up and availabilities multiply — five services at 99.9% in a chain give about 99.5%.", từ "latency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Latencies add up and availabilities multiply — five services at 99.9% in a chain give about 99.5%.", what does "latency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: latency /ˈleɪtənsi/ (danh từ): độ trễ. Latency là thời gian trễ; "latencies add up" = độ trễ cộng dồn qua mỗi dịch vụ trong chuỗi.
items.explanationEn: latency /ˈleɪtənsi/ (noun): delay before a response. Latency is the waiting time; "latencies add up" means each service in the chain adds its own delay.

items.question: Trong câu "Latencies add up and availabilities multiply — five services at 99.9% in a chain give about 99.5%.", từ "multiply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Latencies add up and availabilities multiply — five services at 99.9% in a chain give about 99.5%.", what does "multiply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: multiply /ˈmʌltɪplaɪ/ (động từ): nhân lên với nhau. Availabilities multiply: độ sẵn sàng của từng dịch vụ nhân với nhau, 0.999^5 ≈ 0.995.
items.explanationEn: multiply /ˈmʌltɪplaɪ/ (verb): to combine by multiplying. Availabilities multiply: each service's availability is multiplied together, so 0.999^5 ≈ 0.995.

items.question: Trong câu "With asynchronous messaging the producer hands a message to a broker and moves on; the consumer processes it when it can.", từ "broker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With asynchronous messaging the producer hands a message to a broker and moves on; the consumer processes it when it can.", what does "broker" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: broker /ˈbrəʊkə(r)/ (danh từ): hệ thống trung gian. Broker vốn là người môi giới; trong kỹ thuật là hệ thống trung gian nhận và chuyển tiếp message.
items.explanationEn: broker /ˈbrəʊkə(r)/ (noun): an intermediary system. A broker is originally an agent who arranges deals; in software it is the middle system that receives and forwards messages.

items.question: Trong câu "A broker buys temporal decoupling (consumers can be down for a deploy), load levelling (a spike of 10,000 orders/s is drained at 2,000/s instead of hitting the database), fan-out (email, fraud and analytics all react to one event) and independent scaling.", từ "spike" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A broker buys temporal decoupling (consumers can be down for a deploy), load levelling (a spike of 10,000 orders/s is drained at 2,000/s instead of hitting the database), fan-out (email, fraud and analytics all react to one event) and independent scaling.", what does "spike" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spike /spaɪk/ (danh từ): sự tăng vọt đột ngột. "A spike of traffic" = lưu lượng tăng vọt; nghĩa gốc của spike là vật nhọn, đầu nhọn.
items.explanationEn: spike /spaɪk/ (noun): a sudden sharp increase. "A spike in traffic" is a sudden jump; the literal meaning of spike is a sharp pointed object.

items.question: Trong câu "A broker buys temporal decoupling (consumers can be down for a deploy), load levelling (a spike of 10,000 orders/s is drained at 2,000/s instead of hitting the database), fan-out (email, fraud and analytics all react to one event) and independent scaling.", từ "drain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A broker buys temporal decoupling (consumers can be down for a deploy), load levelling (a spike of 10,000 orders/s is drained at 2,000/s instead of hitting the database), fan-out (email, fraud and analytics all react to one event) and independent scaling.", what does "drain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drain /dreɪn/ (động từ): xử lý dần cho vơi. Drain = rút cạn dần (như nước chảy khỏi bồn); ở đây hàng đợi được xử lý dần với tốc độ 2.000 đơn/giây.
items.explanationEn: drain /dreɪn/ (verb): to empty gradually. Drain means to empty little by little, like water leaving a sink; here the backlog is worked off at 2,000 orders per second.

items.question: Trong câu "A broker buys temporal decoupling (consumers can be down for a deploy), load levelling (a spike of 10,000 orders/s is drained at 2,000/s instead of hitting the database), fan-out (email, fraud and analytics all react to one event) and independent scaling.", từ "decoupling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A broker buys temporal decoupling (consumers can be down for a deploy), load levelling (a spike of 10,000 orders/s is drained at 2,000/s instead of hitting the database), fan-out (email, fraud and analytics all react to one event) and independent scaling.", what does "decoupling" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: decoupling /diːˈkʌplɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự tách rời phụ thuộc. Temporal decoupling = tách rời về thời gian: producer và consumer không cần chạy cùng lúc.
items.explanationEn: decoupling /diːˈkʌplɪŋ/ (noun): removal of a dependency. Temporal decoupling means the producer and consumer do not need to be running at the same time.

items.question: Trong câu "It costs eventual consistency, duplicates and disorder you must design for, harder debugging (trace IDs must travel in headers), and one more stateful system to run.", từ "eventual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It costs eventual consistency, duplicates and disorder you must design for, harder debugging (trace IDs must travel in headers), and one more stateful system to run.", what does "eventual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: eventual /ɪˈventʃuəl/ (tính từ): xảy ra sau cùng. Eventual consistency = nhất quán cuối cùng: dữ liệu sẽ khớp sau một khoảng trễ. Đừng nhầm eventual với "có thể".
items.explanationEn: eventual /ɪˈventʃuəl/ (adjective): happening in the end. Eventual consistency means data will match after some delay; eventual does not mean "possible".

items.question: Trong câu "It costs eventual consistency, duplicates and disorder you must design for, harder debugging (trace IDs must travel in headers), and one more stateful system to run.", từ "disorder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It costs eventual consistency, duplicates and disorder you must design for, harder debugging (trace IDs must travel in headers), and one more stateful system to run.", what does "disorder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: disorder /dɪsˈɔːdə(r)/ (danh từ): sự sai thứ tự. Disorder ở đây là message đến sai thứ tự; trong y học disorder còn nghĩa là chứng rối loạn.
items.explanationEn: disorder /dɪsˈɔːdə(r)/ (noun): lack of correct order. Here disorder means messages arriving out of order; in medicine a disorder is an illness.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: sync when the caller needs the answer to continue (auth, price check); async when the work can happen after you reply (emails, invoices, indexing).", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: sync when the caller needs the answer to continue (auth, price check); async when the work can happen after you reply (emails, invoices, indexing).", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): nguyên tắc kinh nghiệm. Rule of thumb = nguyên tắc ước lượng dựa trên kinh nghiệm, dùng được trong đa số trường hợp.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a rough practical guideline. A rule of thumb is a rough guideline based on experience that works in most cases.

items.question: Trong câu "The key shift with a log: reading does not remove data.", từ "shift" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key shift with a log: reading does not remove data.", what does "shift" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (danh từ): sự thay đổi căn bản. "The key shift" = thay đổi then chốt; shift còn nghĩa là ca làm việc (night shift).
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (noun): a change in approach. "The key shift" is the most important change; shift can also mean a work period, as in "night shift".

items.question: Trong câu "Consumers are cursors into a durable, ordered file, so a new service can bootstrap by reading a Kafka topic from offset 0 — impossible with SQS.", từ "cursor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consumers are cursors into a durable, ordered file, so a new service can bootstrap by reading a Kafka topic from offset 0 — impossible with SQS.", what does "cursor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cursor /ˈkɜːsə(r)/ (danh từ): con trỏ vị trí đọc. Cursor ở đây là con trỏ đánh dấu vị trí đang đọc trong log, không phải con trỏ chuột.
items.explanationEn: cursor /ˈkɜːsə(r)/ (noun): a marker of read position. Here a cursor marks the current reading position in the log, not the pointer on your screen.

items.question: Trong câu "Consumers are cursors into a durable, ordered file, so a new service can bootstrap by reading a Kafka topic from offset 0 — impossible with SQS.", từ "durable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consumers are cursors into a durable, ordered file, so a new service can bootstrap by reading a Kafka topic from offset 0 — impossible with SQS.", what does "durable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: durable /ˈdjʊərəbl/ (tính từ): bền, lưu lâu dài. Durable storage = lưu trữ bền vững, không mất khi khởi động lại; danh từ là durability.
items.explanationEn: durable /ˈdjʊərəbl/ (adjective): long-lasting, not lost. Durable storage survives restarts and crashes; the noun is durability.

items.question: Trong câu "Consumers are cursors into a durable, ordered file, so a new service can bootstrap by reading a Kafka topic from offset 0 — impossible with SQS.", từ "bootstrap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consumers are cursors into a durable, ordered file, so a new service can bootstrap by reading a Kafka topic from offset 0 — impossible with SQS.", what does "bootstrap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bootstrap /ˈbuːtstræp/ (động từ): tự khởi tạo từ đầu. Bootstrap = tự dựng trạng thái ban đầu; service mới đọc lại topic từ offset 0 để có đủ dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: bootstrap /ˈbuːtstræp/ (verb): to start up from scratch. To bootstrap is to build your initial state yourself; a new service replays the topic from offset 0.

items.question: Trong câu "RabbitMQ implements AMQP 0-9-1 (port 5672, TLS 5671, management UI 15672).", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RabbitMQ implements AMQP 0-9-1 (port 5672, TLS 5671, management UI 15672).", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪmplɪment/ (động từ): hiện thực, triển khai. "Implement a protocol" = hiện thực một giao thức; danh từ là implementation.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪmplɪment/ (verb): to put into practice. To implement a protocol is to build software that follows it; the noun is implementation.

items.question: Trong câu "The nameless default exchange binds every queue by its own name", từ "nameless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The nameless default exchange binds every queue by its own name", what does "nameless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: nameless /ˈneɪmləs/ (tính từ): không có tên. Hậu tố -less = không có: nameless, stateless, serverless.
items.explanationEn: nameless /ˈneɪmləs/ (adjective): having no name. The suffix -less means "without": nameless, stateless, serverless.

items.question: Trong câu "The nameless default exchange binds every queue by its own name", từ "bind" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The nameless default exchange binds every queue by its own name", what does "bind" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fasten pages into a book
items.explanation: bind /baɪnd/ (động từ): gắn kết, liên kết. Bind (quá khứ bound) = gắn kết; danh từ binding là liên kết giữa exchange và queue.
items.explanationEn: bind /baɪnd/ (verb): to attach or link. Bind (past tense bound) means to link; a binding is the link between an exchange and a queue.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", từ "reliability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", what does "reliability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reliability /rɪˌlaɪəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): độ tin cậy. Reliability = độ tin cậy; tính từ là reliable.
items.explanationEn: reliability /rɪˌlaɪəˈbɪləti/ (noun): being dependable. Reliability is how dependable a system is; the adjective is reliable.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", từ "knob" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", what does "knob" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: knob /nɒb/ (danh từ): thông số điều chỉnh. Knob nghĩa đen là núm vặn, tay nắm; nghĩa bóng là thông số có thể chỉnh.
items.explanationEn: knob /nɒb/ (noun): an adjustable setting. A knob is literally a round handle or dial; figuratively it is a setting you can tune.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", từ "redeliver" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", what does "redeliver" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: redeliver /ˌriːdɪˈlɪvə(r)/ (động từ): giao lại lần nữa. Tiền tố re- = lại: redeliver, requeue, retry.
items.explanationEn: redeliver /ˌriːdɪˈlɪvə(r)/ (verb): to deliver again. The prefix re- means "again": redeliver, requeue, retry.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): giới hạn mức tối đa. Cap (động từ) = đặt mức trần; danh từ cap là mức trần, cũng là cái mũ hoặc nắp.
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit. To cap is to set a maximum; as a noun, cap is a limit or a hat or lid.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", từ "hoard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", what does "hoard" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to grab and keep too many
items.explanation: hoard /hɔːd/ (động từ): ôm giữ quá nhiều. Hoard = tích trữ, ôm giữ; prefetch ngăn một worker chậm ôm hàng nghìn message.
items.explanationEn: hoard /hɔːd/ (verb): to grab and keep too many. To hoard is to stockpile for yourself; prefetch stops one slow worker holding thousands of messages.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", từ "persistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", what does "persistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: persistent /pəˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): được ghi bền xuống đĩa. Persistent message được ghi xuống đĩa; nói về người, persistent nghĩa là kiên trì.
items.explanationEn: persistent /pəˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): saved to survive restarts. A persistent message is written to disk; about a person, persistent means determined.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", từ "quorum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", what does "quorum" (noun) mean?
options: đa số tối thiểu để thông qua
items.explanation: quorum /ˈkwɔːrəm/ (danh từ): đa số tối thiểu để thông qua. Quorum = số thành viên tối thiểu (thường là đa số) cần đồng ý; quorum queue chỉ ghi nhận khi đa số node xác nhận.
items.explanationEn: quorum /ˈkwɔːrəm/ (noun): a minimum majority to decide. A quorum is the minimum number, usually a majority, that must agree; a quorum queue confirms once most nodes have the message.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", từ "mirrored" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability knobs: consumer acks (un-acked messages are redelivered; auto-ack means at-most-once), prefetch (basic.qos, caps un-acked messages per consumer so one slow worker cannot hoard thousands), publisher confirms, durable queues + persistent messages, and quorum queues (Raft-replicated; classic mirrored queues were removed in RabbitMQ 4.0).", what does "mirrored" (adjective) mean?
options: được sao y sang node khác
items.explanation: mirrored /ˈmɪrəd/ (tính từ): được sao y sang node khác. Mirror = gương; mirrored queue là hàng đợi được sao y sang node khác.
items.explanationEn: mirrored /ˈmɪrəd/ (adjective): copied onto other nodes. A mirror reflects an image; a mirrored queue is copied to other nodes.

items.question: Trong câu "Ignores the key, copies to all bound queues", từ "ignore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ignores the key, copies to all bound queues", what does "ignore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔː(r)/ (động từ): bỏ qua, không xét. Fanout exchange ignores the key = không xét routing key, gửi bản sao cho mọi queue.
items.explanationEn: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔː(r)/ (verb): to pay no attention to. A fanout exchange ignores the routing key and copies the message to every bound queue.

items.question: Trong câu "Kafka is a distributed commit log (port 9092).", từ "distributed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kafka is a distributed commit log (port 9092).", what does "distributed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (tính từ): phân tán trên nhiều máy. Distributed system = hệ phân tán chạy trên nhiều máy; động từ distribute còn nghĩa là phân phát.
items.explanationEn: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (adjective): spread across many machines. A distributed system runs across many machines; the verb distribute can also mean to hand out.

items.question: Trong câu "The broker appends records to files and serves them by offset; consumers do the bookkeeping.", từ "append" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The broker appends records to files and serves them by offset; consumers do the bookkeeping.", what does "append" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in a new order
items.explanation: append /əˈpend/ (động từ): nối thêm vào cuối. Append-only = chỉ ghi nối vào cuối, không sửa bản ghi cũ.
items.explanationEn: append /əˈpend/ (verb): to add at the end. Append-only means you only add to the end and never change old records.

items.question: Trong câu "The broker appends records to files and serves them by offset; consumers do the bookkeeping.", từ "bookkeeping" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The broker appends records to files and serves them by offset; consumers do the bookkeeping.", what does "bookkeeping" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bookkeeping /ˈbʊkkiːpɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc theo dõi, ghi sổ. Bookkeeping gốc là ghi sổ kế toán; trong kỹ thuật là việc theo dõi trạng thái như offset.
items.explanationEn: bookkeeping /ˈbʊkkiːpɪŋ/ (noun): keeping track of records. Bookkeeping originally means keeping financial records; in software it means tracking state such as offsets.

items.question: Trong câu "Data is kept for a retention period (log.retention.hours default 168 = 7 days) whether or not anyone read it.", từ "retention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data is kept for a retention period (log.retention.hours default 168 = 7 days) whether or not anyone read it.", what does "retention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: retention /rɪˈtenʃn/ (danh từ): sự lưu giữ. Retention period = thời gian lưu giữ; động từ là retain.
items.explanationEn: retention /rɪˈtenʃn/ (noun): the keeping of something. The retention period is how long data is kept; the verb is retain.

items.question: Trong câu "Log compaction instead keeps the latest record per key.", từ "compaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log compaction instead keeps the latest record per key.", what does "compaction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compaction /kəmˈpækʃn/ (danh từ): sự nén gọn lại. Log compaction nén gọn log, chỉ giữ bản ghi mới nhất cho mỗi key.
items.explanationEn: compaction /kəmˈpækʃn/ (noun): making smaller and denser. Log compaction shrinks the log by keeping only the latest record for each key.

items.question: Trong câu "Each partition has a leader and followers on other brokers; caught-up followers form the ISR (in-sync replicas).", từ "replica" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each partition has a leader and followers on other brokers; caught-up followers form the ISR (in-sync replicas).", what does "replica" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: replica /ˈreplɪkə/ (danh từ): bản sao. Replica = bản sao; replication là sự nhân bản, replication factor là số bản sao.
items.explanationEn: replica /ˈreplɪkə/ (noun): an exact copy. A replica is a copy; replication is the copying, and the replication factor is how many copies exist.

items.question: Trong câu "With these, a write is acknowledged only when two replicas have it: one broker can die with no data loss.", từ "acknowledge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With these, a write is acknowledged only when two replicas have it: one broker can die with no data loss.", what does "acknowledge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: acknowledge /əkˈnɒlɪdʒ/ (động từ): xác nhận đã nhận. Acknowledge (viết tắt ack) = xác nhận đã nhận; trong đời thường còn nghĩa là thừa nhận.
items.explanationEn: acknowledge /əkˈnɒlɪdʒ/ (verb): to confirm receipt. Acknowledge (short form ack) means to confirm receipt; in daily speech it can also mean to admit.

items.question: Trong câu "If fewer replicas are in sync, producers get NotEnoughReplicas — Kafka picks consistency over availability.", từ "consistency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If fewer replicas are in sync, producers get NotEnoughReplicas — Kafka picks consistency over availability.", what does "consistency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consistency /kənˈsɪstənsi/ (danh từ): tính nhất quán dữ liệu. Consistency trong định lý CAP = mọi bản sao thấy cùng dữ liệu; Kafka ưu tiên nó hơn availability.
items.explanationEn: consistency /kənˈsɪstənsi/ (noun): data agreeing everywhere. In CAP terms, consistency means every replica sees the same data; Kafka prefers it over availability.

items.question: Trong câu "Metadata used to live in ZooKeeper; Kafka now uses KRaft (built-in Raft controllers), and Kafka 4.0 removed ZooKeeper entirely.", từ "entirely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Metadata used to live in ZooKeeper; Kafka now uses KRaft (built-in Raft controllers), and Kafka 4.0 removed ZooKeeper entirely.", what does "entirely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪəli/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn. "Removed ZooKeeper entirely" = loại bỏ hoàn toàn, không còn chế độ dùng ZooKeeper.
items.explanationEn: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪəli/ (adverb): completely. "Removed ZooKeeper entirely" means it is gone completely, with no ZooKeeper mode left.

items.question: Trong câu "Each partition is assigned to exactly one consumer in the group — parallelism plus per-partition order.", từ "assign" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each partition is assigned to exactly one consumer in the group — parallelism plus per-partition order.", what does "assign" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (động từ): gán, phân công. "Be assigned to" = được gán cho; mỗi partition được giao cho đúng một consumer trong nhóm.
items.explanationEn: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (verb): to allocate to someone. "Be assigned to" means to be given to; each partition goes to exactly one consumer in the group.

items.question: Trong câu "Each partition is assigned to exactly one consumer in the group — parallelism plus per-partition order.", từ "parallelism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each partition is assigned to exactly one consumer in the group — parallelism plus per-partition order.", what does "parallelism" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: doing work at the same time
items.explanation: parallelism /ˈpærəlelɪzəm/ (danh từ): việc chạy song song. Parallelism = mức độ song song; số consumer làm việc hiệu quả tối đa bằng số partition.
items.explanationEn: parallelism /ˈpærəlelɪzəm/ (noun): doing work at the same time. Parallelism is how much work runs at once; useful consumers are capped by the partition count.

items.question: Trong câu "Rebalances happen when consumers join, leave, or exceed max.poll.interval.ms (default 5 min) — slow work inside the poll loop causes rebalance storms.", từ "exceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rebalances happen when consumers join, leave, or exceed max.poll.interval.ms (default 5 min) — slow work inside the poll loop causes rebalance storms.", what does "exceed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Exceed a limit" = vượt quá giới hạn; poll chậm quá max.poll.interval.ms sẽ gây rebalance.
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to go beyond. To exceed a limit is to go past it; polling slower than max.poll.interval.ms triggers a rebalance.

items.question: Trong câu "Growing lag is the key health signal.", từ "lag" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Growing lag is the key health signal.", what does "lag" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: lag /læɡ/ (danh từ): khoảng tụt lại phía sau. Consumer lag = số message consumer còn tụt lại so với cuối log; lag tăng dần là dấu hiệu có sự cố.
items.explanationEn: lag /læɡ/ (noun): the gap left behind. Consumer lag is how far a consumer is behind the end of the log; steadily growing lag signals trouble.

items.question: Trong câu "A classic mistake is using Kafka as a job queue: one slow or poison message blocks its partition (head-of-line blocking), and per-message retry must be hand-built.", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A classic mistake is using Kafka as a job queue: one slow or poison message blocks its partition (head-of-line blocking), and per-message retry must be hand-built.", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (tính từ): điển hình, hay gặp. "A classic mistake" = lỗi điển hình mà nhiều người hay mắc.
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (adjective): typical, well-known. "A classic mistake" is a typical error that many people make.

items.question: Trong câu "A classic mistake is using Kafka as a job queue: one slow or poison message blocks its partition (head-of-line blocking), and per-message retry must be hand-built.", từ "hand-built" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A classic mistake is using Kafka as a job queue: one slow or poison message blocks its partition (head-of-line blocking), and per-message retry must be hand-built.", what does "hand-built" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hand-built /ˌhændˈbɪlt/ (tính từ): tự viết thủ công. Hand-built = tự xây dựng thủ công, trái với built-in (có sẵn).
items.explanationEn: hand-built /ˌhændˈbɪlt/ (adjective): made manually by yourself. Hand-built means you must write it yourself, the opposite of built-in.

items.question: Trong câu "systems offer exactly-once processing inside a boundary", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "systems offer exactly-once processing inside a boundary", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (danh từ): ranh giới, phạm vi. "Inside a boundary" = trong một phạm vi giới hạn, ví dụ chỉ trong Kafka → Kafka.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (noun): a limit or border. "Inside a boundary" means within a limited scope, such as Kafka to Kafka only.

items.question: Trong câu "It holds only Kafka → Kafka; an external DB or API call puts you back at at-least-once.", từ "external" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It holds only Kafka → Kafka; an external DB or API call puts you back at at-least-once.", what does "external" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: external /ɪkˈstɜːnl/ (tính từ): bên ngoài. External DB/API = hệ thống bên ngoài Kafka; trái nghĩa là internal.
items.explanationEn: external /ɪkˈstɜːnl/ (adjective): outside. An external DB or API lives outside Kafka; the opposite is internal.

items.question: Trong câu "SQS FIFO — drops messages with the same deduplication ID within a 5-minute window.", từ "window" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQS FIFO — drops messages with the same deduplication ID within a 5-minute window.", what does "window" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: window /ˈwɪndəʊ/ (danh từ): khoảng thời gian. "Time window" = khung thời gian; SQS FIFO khử trùng lặp trong khung 5 phút.
items.explanationEn: window /ˈwɪndəʊ/ (noun): a limited period of time. A time window is a limited period; SQS FIFO removes duplicates within five minutes.

items.question: Trong câu "Idempotent means applying a message twice has the same effect as once.", từ "idempotent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Idempotent means applying a message twice has the same effect as once.", what does "idempotent" (adjective) mean?
options: lặp lại thì chạy nhanh hơn
mỗi lần cho kết quả khác
lặp lại vẫn cùng kết quả
items.explanation: idempotent /ˌaɪdəmˈpəʊtənt/ (tính từ): lặp lại vẫn cùng kết quả. Idempotent: áp dụng hai lần có tác dụng như một lần; danh từ là idempotency.
items.explanationEn: idempotent /ˌaɪdəmˈpəʊtənt/ (adjective): same result when repeated. Idempotent means doing it twice has the same effect as once; the noun is idempotency.

items.question: Trong câu "Naturally idempotent writes — SET status = 'SHIPPED' or an upsert is safe; balance = balance - 10 is not.", từ "naturally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Naturally idempotent writes — SET status = 'SHIPPED' or an upsert is safe; balance = balance - 10 is not.", what does "naturally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: naturally /ˈnætʃrəli/ (trạng từ): vốn dĩ, tự bản chất. Naturally idempotent = tự bản chất đã idempotent, không cần thêm cơ chế nào.
items.explanationEn: naturally /ˈnætʃrəli/ (adverb): by its own nature. Naturally idempotent means safe to repeat by design, with no extra mechanism.

items.question: Trong câu "Conditional writes — UPDATE ... WHERE version = 7; a replay finds version 8 and does nothing.", từ "conditional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conditional writes — UPDATE ... WHERE version = 7; a replay finds version 8 and does nothing.", what does "conditional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conditional /kənˈdɪʃənl/ (tính từ): có điều kiện. Conditional write chỉ ghi khi điều kiện (ví dụ version = 7) còn đúng.
items.explanationEn: conditional /kənˈdɪʃənl/ (adjective): depending on a condition. A conditional write only succeeds while its condition, such as version = 7, still holds.

items.question: Trong câu "Dedup table — record the event ID in the same transaction as the side effect.", từ "side effect" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dedup table — record the event ID in the same transaction as the side effect.", what does "side effect" (phrase) mean?
options: tác động làm đổi trạng thái
items.explanation: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪfekt/ (cụm từ): tác động làm đổi trạng thái. Side effect trong lập trình là thay đổi bên ngoài hàm (ghi DB, trừ tiền); trong y khoa là tác dụng phụ.
items.explanationEn: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪfekt/ (phrase): a change made to state. In programming a side effect is a change outside the function, such as a DB write; in medicine it is an unwanted reaction.

items.question: Trong câu "Use an event ID created by the producer, not a broker delivery ID (an SQS receipt handle changes on every receive).", từ "receipt" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use an event ID created by the producer, not a broker delivery ID (an SQS receipt handle changes on every receive).", what does "receipt" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (danh từ): việc nhận, biên nhận. Receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (chữ p câm) = sự nhận, biên nhận; receipt handle thay đổi sau mỗi lần nhận.
items.explanationEn: receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (noun): proof of receiving. Receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (silent p) means the act or proof of receiving; do not confuse it with recipe.

items.question: Trong câu "Dedup insert and side effect must be atomic; two commits recreate the gap.", từ "atomic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dedup insert and side effect must be atomic; two commits recreate the gap.", what does "atomic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: atomic /əˈtɒmɪk/ (tính từ): trọn vẹn, không chia cắt. Atomic operation = thao tác trọn gói: hoặc thành công hết hoặc không có gì thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: atomic /əˈtɒmɪk/ (adjective): all-or-nothing, indivisible. An atomic operation is all-or-nothing: either every part succeeds or nothing changes.

items.question: Trong câu "Expire dedup rows only after your maximum redelivery/replay window.", từ "expire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Expire dedup rows only after your maximum redelivery/replay window.", what does "expire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expire /ɪkˈspaɪə(r)/ (động từ): cho hết hạn. Expire = hết hạn; ở đây là cho các dòng dedup hết hạn và xóa sau cửa sổ redelivery.
items.explanationEn: expire /ɪkˈspaɪə(r)/ (verb): to let run out. Expire means to reach the end of a valid period; here dedup rows are removed after the redelivery window.

items.question: Trong câu "Global order and horizontal scale conflict: one ordered stream means one consumer.", từ "conflict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Global order and horizontal scale conflict: one ordered stream means one consumer.", what does "conflict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: conflict /kənˈflɪkt/ (động từ): mâu thuẫn, xung khắc. Động từ conflict /kənˈflɪkt/ nhấn âm 2; danh từ /ˈkɒnflɪkt/ nhấn âm 1.
items.explanationEn: conflict /kənˈflɪkt/ (verb): to clash with each other. The verb conflict /kənˈflɪkt/ stresses the second syllable; the noun /ˈkɒnflɪkt/ stresses the first.

items.question: Trong câu "Global order and horizontal scale conflict: one ordered stream means one consumer.", từ "horizontal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Global order and horizontal scale conflict: one ordered stream means one consumer.", what does "horizontal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: horizontal /ˌhɒrɪˈzɒntl/ (tính từ): mở rộng bằng thêm máy. Horizontal scale = mở rộng ngang bằng cách thêm máy; vertical scale = nâng cấp một máy.
items.explanationEn: horizontal /ˌhɒrɪˈzɒntl/ (adjective): by adding more machines. Horizontal scaling adds more machines; vertical scaling makes one machine bigger.

items.question: Trong câu "What silently breaks order: retries that requeue to the back, several consumers or threads on one ordered stream, changing a keyed topic's partition count, and working around hot keys (one huge tenant on one partition).", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What silently breaks order: retries that requeue to the back, several consumers or threads on one ordered stream, changing a keyed topic's partition count, and working around hot keys (one huge tenant on one partition).", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (trạng từ): âm thầm, không báo lỗi. "Silently breaks" = làm hỏng mà không có lỗi hay cảnh báo; "fail silently" là lỗi khó phát hiện.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (adverb): without any warning. "Silently breaks" means it fails with no error or warning, which makes it hard to notice.

items.question: Trong câu "What silently breaks order: retries that requeue to the back, several consumers or threads on one ordered stream, changing a keyed topic's partition count, and working around hot keys (one huge tenant on one partition).", từ "tenant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What silently breaks order: retries that requeue to the back, several consumers or threads on one ordered stream, changing a keyed topic's partition count, and working around hot keys (one huge tenant on one partition).", what does "tenant" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a customer on a shared system
items.explanation: tenant /ˈtenənt/ (danh từ): khách hàng trên hệ thống. Tenant gốc là người thuê nhà; multi-tenant = nhiều khách hàng dùng chung một hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: tenant /ˈtenənt/ (noun): a customer on a shared system. A tenant is originally someone renting a home; multi-tenant means many customers share one system.

items.question: Trong câu "Often the better design is to tolerate disorder: carry a version in each event and ignore events older than the stored state.", từ "tolerate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Often the better design is to tolerate disorder: carry a version in each event and ignore events older than the stored state.", what does "tolerate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: tolerate /ˈtɒləreɪt/ (động từ): chấp nhận, chịu được. "Tolerate disorder" = chấp nhận message sai thứ tự; fault tolerance = khả năng chịu lỗi.
items.explanationEn: tolerate /ˈtɒləreɪt/ (verb): to accept and cope with. "Tolerate disorder" means cope with out-of-order messages; fault tolerance is the ability to survive failures.

items.question: Trong câu "Transient failures (timeout, 503, lock conflict) → retry after a delay.", từ "transient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transient failures (timeout, 503, lock conflict) → retry after a delay.", what does "transient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: transient /ˈtrænziənt/ (tính từ): tạm thời, thoáng qua. Transient failure = lỗi tạm thời, thử lại sau một lúc thường sẽ thành công.
items.explanationEn: transient /ˈtrænziənt/ (adjective): short-lived, passing. A transient failure is temporary, so a retry after a short wait usually succeeds.

items.question: Trong câu "Poison messages (malformed payload, bug) → retrying forever wastes capacity and, in a log, blocks the partition.", từ "malformed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Poison messages (malformed payload, bug) → retrying forever wastes capacity and, in a log, blocks the partition.", what does "malformed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: malformed /ˌmælˈfɔːmd/ (tính từ): sai định dạng. Tiền tố mal- = xấu, sai: malformed, malware, malfunction.
items.explanationEn: malformed /ˌmælˈfɔːmd/ (adjective): wrongly structured. The prefix mal- means "bad": malformed, malware, malfunction.

items.question: Trong câu "Poison messages (malformed payload, bug) → retrying forever wastes capacity and, in a log, blocks the partition.", từ "payload" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Poison messages (malformed payload, bug) → retrying forever wastes capacity and, in a log, blocks the partition.", what does "payload" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: payload /ˈpeɪləʊd/ (danh từ): phần dữ liệu chính. Payload là phần nội dung thực của message; nghĩa gốc là hàng hóa, tải trọng mà xe hay tên lửa chở.
items.explanationEn: payload /ˈpeɪləʊd/ (noun): the main data carried. The payload is the actual content of a message; originally it is the cargo a vehicle or rocket carries.

items.question: Trong câu "Poison messages (malformed payload, bug) → retrying forever wastes capacity and, in a log, blocks the partition.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Poison messages (malformed payload, bug) → retrying forever wastes capacity and, in a log, blocks the partition.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (danh từ): năng lực xử lý. "Waste capacity" = lãng phí năng lực xử lý; "in my capacity as" = với tư cách là.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (noun): ability to handle work. "Waste capacity" means using up processing power for nothing; "in my capacity as" means in my role as.

items.question: Trong câu "Park them.", từ "park" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Park them.", what does "park" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to leave a car in a spot
items.explanation: park /pɑːk/ (động từ): tạm gác sang một bên. Park nghĩa bóng = tạm để sang một bên xử lý sau, giống như đỗ xe vào chỗ riêng.
items.explanationEn: park /pɑːk/ (verb): to set aside for later. Figuratively, to park something is to set it aside for later, like leaving a car in a spot.

items.question: Trong câu "Exponential backoff with jitter stops consumers retrying in lockstep against a recovering dependency", từ "exponential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exponential backoff with jitter stops consumers retrying in lockstep against a recovering dependency", what does "exponential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: exponential /ˌekspəˈnenʃl/ (tính từ): tăng theo cấp số nhân. Exponential backoff: chờ 1, 2, 4, 8… giây, mỗi lần gấp đôi.
items.explanationEn: exponential /ˌekspəˈnenʃl/ (adjective): growing by multiplication. With exponential backoff you wait 1, 2, 4, 8… seconds, doubling each time.

items.question: Trong câu "Exponential backoff with jitter stops consumers retrying in lockstep against a recovering dependency", từ "in lockstep" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exponential backoff with jitter stops consumers retrying in lockstep against a recovering dependency", what does "in lockstep" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in lockstep /ɪn ˈlɒkstep/ (cụm từ): đồng loạt, cùng nhịp. "In lockstep" = cùng nhịp như đội diễu hành; nhiều consumer retry cùng lúc sẽ dồn tải vào dependency.
items.explanationEn: in lockstep /ɪn ˈlɒkstep/ (phrase): all together in exact step. "In lockstep" means moving in exact step like marching soldiers; synchronized retries overload the dependency.

items.question: Trong câu "Exponential backoff with jitter stops consumers retrying in lockstep against a recovering dependency", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exponential backoff with jitter stops consumers retrying in lockstep against a recovering dependency", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
options: dịch vụ mà ta phụ thuộc
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): dịch vụ mà ta phụ thuộc. Dependency = thứ mà hệ thống phụ thuộc (DB, API, thư viện); "recovering dependency" = dịch vụ đang hồi phục.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): a service you rely on. A dependency is something your system relies on, such as a DB or API; a recovering one is coming back after failure.

items.question: Trong câu "an unacknowledged message reappears after the visibility timeout (default 30 s, max 12 h)", từ "reappear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an unacknowledged message reappears after the visibility timeout (default 30 s, max 12 h)", what does "reappear" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reappear /ˌriːəˈpɪə(r)/ (động từ): xuất hiện lại. Re- + appear; message chưa bị xóa sẽ hiện lại trong hàng đợi sau visibility timeout.
items.explanationEn: reappear /ˌriːəˈpɪə(r)/ (verb): to appear again. Re- plus appear; an undeleted message becomes visible again after the visibility timeout.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep the timeout above worst-case processing time.", từ "worst-case" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep the timeout above worst-case processing time.", what does "worst-case" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worst-case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (tính từ): xấu nhất có thể. Worst-case processing time = thời gian xử lý lâu nhất có thể; timeout phải lớn hơn mức này.
items.explanationEn: worst-case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (adjective): the worst possible. Worst-case processing time is the longest a job can take; the timeout must be above it.

items.question: Trong câu "Alert on DLQ depth > 0 — an unwatched DLQ is a slow way to lose data.", từ "depth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Alert on DLQ depth > 0 — an unwatched DLQ is a slow way to lose data.", what does "depth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: depth /depθ/ (danh từ): số lượng tồn trong hàng. Queue depth = số message đang nằm trong hàng đợi; DLQ depth > 0 nghĩa là đã có message lỗi.
items.explanationEn: depth /depθ/ (noun): number of items waiting. Queue depth is how many messages are waiting; a DLQ depth above zero means something failed.

items.question: Trong câu "The relay can crash after publishing but before marking the row, so the outbox is at-least-once: consumers stay idempotent, using the outbox ID as event ID (the receiving side's dedup table is often called an inbox).", từ "relay" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The relay can crash after publishing but before marking the row, so the outbox is at-least-once: consumers stay idempotent, using the outbox ID as event ID (the receiving side's dedup table is often called an inbox).", what does "relay" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: relay /ˈriːleɪ/ (danh từ): tiến trình chuyển tiếp. Relay = bộ chuyển tiếp: đọc outbox rồi publish lên broker; "relay race" là chạy tiếp sức.
items.explanationEn: relay /ˈriːleɪ/ (noun): a process passing things on. A relay passes things along: it reads the outbox and publishes to the broker; a relay race is a team race.

items.question: Trong câu "Outbox is what makes sagas reliable — sagas and CQRS are topic 18.", từ "reliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Outbox is what makes sagas reliable — sagas and CQRS are topic 18.", what does "reliable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reliable /rɪˈlaɪəbl/ (tính từ): đáng tin cậy. "Makes sagas reliable" = làm cho saga đáng tin cậy; danh từ là reliability.
items.explanationEn: reliable /rɪˈlaɪəbl/ (adjective): dependable. "Makes sagas reliable" means they can be depended on; the noun is reliability.

items.question: Trong câu "Tails the WAL/binlog (e.g. Debezium → Kafka)", từ "tail" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tails the WAL/binlog (e.g. Debezium → Kafka)", what does "tail" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: tail /teɪl/ (động từ): bám theo đọc phần mới. Tail (động từ) = bám theo; "tail a log" = đọc liên tục các dòng mới được ghi.
items.explanationEn: tail /teɪl/ (verb): to follow new entries. To tail is to follow closely; tailing a log means reading new lines as they are written.

items.question: Trong câu "Lambda consumers should use ReportBatchItemFailures so one bad message does not retry the whole batch", từ "batch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lambda consumers should use ReportBatchItemFailures so one bad message does not retry the whole batch", what does "batch" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: batch /bætʃ/ (danh từ): lô xử lý cùng lúc. Batch = lô; batching = gom nhiều message xử lý một lần; nghĩa đời thường là một mẻ (bánh).
items.explanationEn: batch /bætʃ/ (noun): a group processed together. A batch is a group handled together; in the kitchen it is a set of things baked at once.

items.question: Trong câu "Sync when the caller needs the answer now; async for work after the reply, at the price of eventual consistency.", từ "at the price of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sync when the caller needs the answer now; async for work after the reply, at the price of eventual consistency.", what does "at the price of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at the price of /æt ðə ˈpraɪs əv/ (cụm từ): với cái giá là. "At the price of X" = đánh đổi bằng X; async được lợi nhưng phải chấp nhận eventual consistency.
items.explanationEn: at the price of /æt ðə ˈpraɪs əv/ (phrase): at the cost of. "At the price of X" means you gain something but must give up X in exchange.

items.question: Trong câu "Backoff with jitter, a retry limit, a monitored DLQ; the outbox fixes dual writes.", từ "monitored" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backoff with jitter, a retry limit, a monitored DLQ; the outbox fixes dual writes.", what does "monitored" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: monitored /ˈmɒnɪtəd/ (tính từ): được giám sát. "A monitored DLQ" = DLQ có theo dõi và cảnh báo; trái nghĩa là unwatched.
items.explanationEn: monitored /ˈmɒnɪtəd/ (adjective): watched over. A monitored DLQ is watched and alerted on; the opposite is unwatched.

items.question: Trong câu "Brokers decouple services in time and absorb spikes, but bring duplicates, disorder and eventual consistency.", từ "decouple" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Brokers decouple services in time and absorb spikes, but bring duplicates, disorder and eventual consistency.", what does "decouple" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decouple /diːˈkʌpl/ (động từ): tách rời phụ thuộc. "Decouple services in time" = làm các dịch vụ không cần chạy cùng lúc; danh từ là decoupling.
items.explanationEn: decouple /diːˈkʌpl/ (verb): to separate dependencies. To decouple services in time means they no longer need to run at the same moment; the noun is decoupling.

items.question: Trong câu "Brokers decouple services in time and absorb spikes, but bring duplicates, disorder and eventual consistency.", từ "absorb" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Brokers decouple services in time and absorb spikes, but bring duplicates, disorder and eventual consistency.", what does "absorb" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: absorb /əbˈzɔːb/ (động từ): hấp thụ, chịu được. "Absorb spikes" = hấp thụ các đợt tăng tải đột biến, như miếng bọt biển hút nước.
items.explanationEn: absorb /əbˈzɔːb/ (verb): to soak up and handle. "Absorb spikes" means soaking up sudden load, like a sponge soaking up water.

items.question: Trong câu "At-least-once plus idempotency, retries with DLQs and the outbox pattern make messaging trustworthy.", từ "trustworthy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At-least-once plus idempotency, retries with DLQs and the outbox pattern make messaging trustworthy.", what does "trustworthy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: trustworthy /ˈtrʌstwɜːði/ (tính từ): đáng tin cậy. Trustworthy = đáng tin; hậu tố -worthy = xứng đáng (trustworthy, noteworthy).
items.explanationEn: trustworthy /ˈtrʌstwɜːði/ (adjective): able to be trusted. Trustworthy means deserving trust; the suffix -worthy means deserving (trustworthy, noteworthy).
